issue.title: Publication de-flap, truthful error digests, and TUI stall reduction
issue.description: agent_publication reports each (project, signature) cause once as a standing alert with a true attempt count and backoff. Its drain does bounded, reusable work with a cleanup that completes and leaves no scratch behind. Unrestorable prompt archives reach an audited terminal state instead of staying quarantined forever. The scheduler error ring and hourly digest group errors by signature, with durable true counts, a truthful coverage interval, and pruned digest files. Policy-initiated TUI garbage collections and sampled main-thread I/O no longer block the event loop for seconds, and tui_stalls.jsonl stays bounded, untorn, and usable as the acceptance metric.
issue.creation_reason: Approved epic plan plan:202611/noise_publication_digests_tui_stalls.md requests this work

issue.title: Group the scheduler error ring by signature with durable interval counts
issue.description: error_groups: a sase-core normalizer turns error text into a stable signature. append_error keeps a durable per-interval counter keyed by (routine, job, signature) next to a signature-fair sample ring. Failed or corrupt writes are counted and logged once instead of dropped.
issue.creation_reason: Epic plan plan:202611/noise_publication_digests_tui_stalls.md defines phase error_groups as one work unit

issue.title: Render one digest line per cause with true totals, coverage, and pruning
issue.description: digest_render: the hourly digest snapshots and resets the interval counter atomically. It renders one line per cause with count, first/last time, and a sample under a true-total and coverage header, with no loss after downtime or a crash. Digest files are pruned on a 30-day horizon.
issue.creation_reason: Epic plan plan:202611/noise_publication_digests_tui_stalls.md defines phase digest_render as one work unit

issue.title: Turn repeated publication failures into standing alerts with backoff
issue.description: pub_standing: a sase-core decider keys publication failures by (project, signature) and reports only opened, changed, escalated, and cleared transitions. It backs off project-scoped failures. A standing store keeps true attempt counts and first/last-seen times, and one notification per alert fires only on transitions.
issue.creation_reason: Epic plan plan:202611/noise_publication_digests_tui_stalls.md defines phase pub_standing as one work unit

issue.title: Give drain cleanup a budget it can finish and sweep stranded publisher scratch
issue.description: pub_cleanup: the drain reserves a cleanup window inside its timeout and records a verifiable cleanup result. Stale .sase-v2-stage/.sase-v2-backup scratch is swept under the publisher lock. Workspace retention stops treating agents-sync scratch in the machine-wide agents sidecar as a run's stranded work.
issue.creation_reason: Epic plan plan:202611/noise_publication_digests_tui_stalls.md defines phase pub_cleanup as one work unit

issue.title: Bound inventory_build with reuse, an incremental history cache, and scoped queries
issue.description: pub_inventory: build the hood inventory once per project per tick instead of once per batch. Cache parsed primary-history trailers by HEAD and parse only new commits. Scope index and dismissed-record queries to the requested hoods, and give inventory_build its own deadline slice.
issue.creation_reason: Epic plan plan:202611/noise_publication_digests_tui_stalls.md defines phase pub_inventory as one work unit

issue.title: Keep deferred prompt sources alive and add an audited terminal state
issue.description: prompt_terminal: find why deferred prompt sources vanish and close each gap so durable obligations keep their bytes. Add a sase-core terminal outcome for genuinely unreconstructable archives. It stops retries, releases pool protection and any tied workspace hold, and leaves an audit record. It never counts as success.

issue.title: Make the publication doctor checks report standing and terminal state
issue.description: pub_doctor: doctor's agent_publication_outbox check groups issues by (project, signature) and reports audited terminal rows as settled, so the count stays flat across ticks. Apply sase-1rb remedy (a): stale-only protection blocks are not a WARN.

issue.title: Rotate tui_stalls.jsonl, tolerate torn lines, and write fault headers only on faults
issue.description: stall_telemetry: tui_stalls.jsonl size-rotates through the shared bounded-append helper and drops its non-atomic in-place prune. Every reader tolerates torn lines, and long stalls get bounded stack re-samples. tui_faults.log gets a header only when a fault actually happens.

issue.title: Stop policy-initiated garbage collections from blocking the loop for seconds
issue.description: gc_policy: idle, backstop, and RSS-backstop collections stay bounded. The policy re-freezes survivors, defers full collections while the process is swapping, and cost-gates the backstops, while keeping the memory backstops. Before/after pause stats are recorded by trigger.
